# cloudxino_kubernetes_cluster (Data Source)

A CKS cluster of the team, by `name` or `id`, with its kubeconfig (for clusters made outside this configuration).

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A cluster made in the console, by name; its kubeconfig is null unless it is active.
data "cloudxino_kubernetes_cluster" "prod" {
  name = "prod"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `name` (String)

### Read-Only

- `endpoint` (String) The Kubernetes API address for kubectl.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `kubeconfig` (String, Sensitive) Admin kubeconfig (YAML); null unless the cluster is active.
- `project_id` (String)
- `region` (String)
- `status` (String)
- `version` (String) Kubernetes version.
